verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a silicon system-on-chip. User-defined event-triggered automation rules are a software or platform capability, not an axis a processor ships, so the story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the M5 itself offering rule-based automation; the cited material covers only compute, GPU, Neural Engine and memory performance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
